title: Comfort
description: The service behind the Ambient Light and Seats apps: any colour on the ambient light (per zone), front seat moves, three memories per seat, the Gentleman function (passenger seat out of the way and back) and easy exit (the driver seat and an electric steering column to your own getting-out position when the driver door opens, back once the door is shut with the ignition or engine on). Through the car's own body and seat modules; seats move at any speed, Make room, easy exit and the steering column only standing.
